company_info.company_name: Progress Electrical and Solar Pty Ltd
company_info.company_description: "Progress Electrical & Solar are your trusted professional solar panel suppliers and installers.With over 30 years combined experience in the electrical industry, we have the knowledge and know- how to deliver the best solution for your situation and budget for all residential and commercial premises.Our products offer industry leading warranties with brands you can count on. We can handle all types of solar designs from small residential installs to 100kW complex commercial projects.We have offices in both Sydney and Newcastle servicing the wider Sydney region, Newcastle, Hunter Valley, Lake Macquarie, Port Stephens, Foster, Taree, Wauchope and Port Macquarie areas.Why Choose Progress:No sub-contractorsQuality componentsIndustry experienceReliable and trustworthyExceptional after-sales service"

reviews.review_description: All aspects of this project were excellent.   Progress Electrical very highly professional and offered a very competitive price for a 10kw standard string system.   It is only 6 days since the installation so am still waiting for the grid connection to happen.   The system is performing well and I am surprised how well it does even on cloudy days.   Very satisfied.
Rob was the sales manager I delt with and he was responsive, knowledgable and patient as we deliberated over solar installation details.
Frustrated with trying to tie down an installation date which is now scheduled for May 5

The sales quoting process was straightforward and efficient plus the old solar panels were removed in a timely manner ready for the roof restoration.The installation was a very smooth process with crew turning up on schedule, completing the work and cleaning up afterwards. I was impressed by their professional work ethic.The chief installer saw to it that my iPad was able to log onto the local solar network supply monitoring program.I was impressed that the 6.6kW system turned on after 14.00 was able to charge the 9.6kWh battery to 53% using only half of the solar panels before sundown.

I received quotes from several different installers, and Progress's professionalism and price were easily the best.The installation team were extremely courteous, professional and hard-working. Nothing was an issue. I had an old system removed and new panels and batteries installed. Once finished, there was no rubbish left onsite.After-sales service has been outstanding. I had an issue (my fault), and the installer quickly contacted the distributor and worked out what I did wrong.Totally recommend this company.

I requested Progress Electrical and Solar to install solar panels to my residence a bit over 12 months ago. I was very happy with the service I have received from initial contact, installation and connection to the grid.I believe I obtained good products at a reasonable price. Both Rob & Mitchell were always contactable and their installation team did a great job.I am extremely happy with the performance of the solar system over the last 12 months

I recently had solar panels installed by Progress Electrical and Solar, and I could not be happier with the entire experience.Rob, the sales guy, was fantastic: he was extremely patient with all my questions and took the time to make sure I understood everything clearly. Mitch and his installation team were equally impressive. They did a very tidy and professional job, and Mitch himself was polite, approachable, and happy to answer all of my questions throughout the process.In my experience, it is rare to find a team that combines technical expertise with such great customer service, but Progress Electrical and Solar delivered on both. I have already recommended them to others and will definitely be using their services again in the future.If you are considering solar or electrical work, I highly recommend giving them a call.

Rob from the sales team was very knowledgeable, didn't try to oversell and answered all my questions regarding the addition of a CatchPower Green and CatchPower Catch Control.Mitchell and the team did a great job on the install and switchboard upgrade. The panels were installed over three aspects with all the wiring done neatly and internally through the roof. They were efficient and polite and left the job site clean and tidy. I have no reservations recommending them for anyone else to get solar.

After negotiating the minefield that is solar and batteries, I decided to lock in Progress Electrical. From quote to install the process couldn’t have been smother. The team turned up when they said they would. They were polite, tidy and took pride in their work. I couldn’t recommend them more highly.

6.6 System installed in December 2023.They provided a comprehensive quote and provided upfront advice on panels and inverter.The system was installed and up and running in 4 hours by the team on a Saturday morning on a day that was predicted to reach 40C.There was 4 of them in the team and they were swift and highly professional. They advised the grid provider and how long it would take to connect to the grid.Installed the system monitoring system on my laptop and explained how to monitor my system. Came back twice since when I had an issue with the on-line monitoring.Local firm, have recommended them to others.

The sales and quoting process was easy to understand. The installers were very polite. The company was able to install earlier than anticipated, which was fantastic. The company organised the grid connection for us.

The sales manager who came to inspect my property was charming, friendly and informative.The team of guys who installed were friendly and efficient and the team leader was patient with all my questions as well as with all the after-sales queries I had.

After a reminder from SolarQuotes, the quoting process was very good, he listened and responded with good information.  Flexible in preparing a variation to the quote.Installation was superb.  A team of 4 that worked extremely hard but were outstandingly polite and quiet on the job.Service advice at installation was good and very quick to respond to additional questions after the install by email.Confident that I chose the right installer, although another company that quoted were very impressive but beaten by price.Thank you to SolarQuotes for their important part in the process.

The sales/quoting process was professional, without high-pressure salesmanship and the technically issues were patiently explained.The installation went very smoothly with the crew arriving on time, friendly and tidied up the job spotlessly.The grid connection was organised for me and I was shown how to monitor the system performance using the ap that was installed on my phone for me.I was invited to telephone the supervisor on the job if I had any issues at all.

Extremely easy process, was very informative. Was the only company that came and did an onsite visit rather then just use google maps. Installation was fast, they arrived at 7:30am and worked through light rain to install. Very professional and clean install.Highly recommend

Our solar was installed only yesterday, so no meter change yet. The installation went smoothly (only a small - 3.5 kW - system) and happened on the appointed day. All rubbish cleaned up and taken away, installers were polite and friendly. We have been copied into the applications for meter change and STCs.My only criticism would be a lack of communication; nothing serious, but a couple of emails, or calls would have kept us "in the loop" a bit more. Notwithstanding this minor quibble, I'd recommend Progress Electrical.
Sales man very helpful.The installation crew were very polite and professonalThey did organise grid connection

Sales process was excellent and they were one of the few to bother to do a site visitInstall was delayed a few weeks but rather than delay the many, next door and i were delayed together but upgraded.One of the young installers was kicking my newly cleaned, sealed and painted roof tiles around with his boot. I called out for him to cease but he ignored me. The boss said something.The app doesn't always work and is regularly off-line (no wi-fi) but all working for everything else and i have not been able to get any support. We are not producing the amount of power as estimated in the report, despite 2 trees since being removed which caused some minor shadowing. In the peak of a sunny day in later March our best result in full sun was 5.6kw on a 7.92kw system. We have not been using any heating today, yet our power consumption is 3 times our usage. I wonder if the system is even working correctly?

Purchased a 10kw , 24 panel system from Progress Electrical.Great sales and excellent installation made this an easy and flawless operation.Thoroughly endorse Rob and this company for all their expertise and professionalism.

Salesman was punctual and informative. Installation was delayed for a few weeks due to weather and foreman’s private schedule. Day of fitment went without any issues. Workers were polite and organised. Handover was rushed and not very detailed possibly because it was a Friday afternoon. Paperwork was left to me to submit contrary to installer’s advice. Left 2 messages for a call back but have not been contacted

They quoted for the system, gave advice on process, timeframe for installation. We accepted their quote and they arrived on the agreed day for install.Installed on a 40C+ day and had the whole install done in 3.5hours. Excellent team who knew exactly what was required. They were quick, punctual and polite. Took great care to ensure no damage to roof or house.They advised they will contact Energy Provider and organize connection and smart meter.
Good advice and information supplied. The panels look great on the roof and so far are very effective.

Rob in sales was great.The installers (Mitch and the team) arrived on site at 7.30am and were finished the job entirely by 1.30pm. They were courteous, professional and informative. I would highly recommend Progress Electrical. Thanks
Very happy with all aspects of the process. Totally recommend this company.

How was the sales/quoting process? Progress Electrical were to only seller who came to home, the others viewed house via Google Earth, some were cheaper and others dearerHow did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual? Yes Yes and Yes,3 man team arrived 7.30 10/8/23 and left around 1.30pmHow was the customer service? e.g. did they help organise the grid co/nnection after the install? Yes they set up the visit by Energy Australia, with the new Smart Meter, which was installed 22/8/23
Prompt, did job quickly and efficiently.  The App showing usage from installed system appears to be inaccurate at times, even after refreshing,

Sales/quoting process excellentInstallation punctual, tidy and explained very wellHelped to organise the grid connectionWas not happy with the follow up after signing the contract and paying the deposit.  It would have been nice to receive a follow up giving an estimated date of installation. But this is a minor whinge.

I definitely could not fault Rob and his team. They were extremely helpful, knowledgeable and highly professional and we are really happy with the quality of the Solar System which they have installed and his prices were very competitive too.I would highly recommend Progress Electrical and Solar to anyone looking to have a solar system installed.

Easy initial meeting with Rob who didn’t try to sell me anything but outlined my options. Mitch and the team did a great job on install. The lads arrived on time, kept me in the loop with any changes and the install was efficient and neat. System integration was easy and has been working well so far. I highly recommend Progress Electrical for your solar installation.
Sales person knowledgeable and easily contactable for follow up questions. Installation went without a hitch. All installed, tidied up and connected to grid in one day.

From Solar Quotes I ended up with 6 quotes with some companies giving alternate options. I only invited one company outside the 3 companies that was recommended, but, somehow, two other companies managed to acquire my phone number!For the 3 companies recommended, the quoting was quite straight forward, with each putting forward their own ideas as to why their quote would be the most suitable. The rest of the quotes came from very pushy salesman with some outrageous deals and pricing!The company I chose was very straight forward in their approach, gave me all the info I needed and left me to make an informed decision.The installation crew turned up on time on the allotted date, were very polite and accommodating, finished the work in about 6 hours, left my premises as clean as they found it and helped me install an appt on my phone to record the operation of the system. They also helped organise the grid connection, which should take place within the next 2 weeks. Their customer service has been very good and I don't expect any problems that might arise to not be able to be dealt with in their efficient manner. An excellent installation!

I’d happily recommend Progress Electrical and am confident they have provided a quality system at a competitive price.All aspects of the installation were professional, the person who came out to assess the property was knowledgeable and friendly.The installation was completed as planned in one day, with no issues. The team were polite and friendly, and worked quietly an efficiently, taking care of the components as they moved them onto the roof. They took the time to have us check that switches were not tripping after the installation. The site was left clean and tidy at the end of the day, all rubbish and packaging was taken away,Once completed Mitch explained how the inverters were set up and provided information to set up the SolarEdge app for monitor the system. They are organising the necessary meter changes with the energy provider; I’ll just have to select a new plan.

The quote was easy to understand and different options explained clearly.The installation team were all those things, polite, tidy and punctual. It was completed earlier than expected.Installation was also sooner than expected given hold-ups created by floods and pestilence.

Sales and customer service were excellent.Had to get different panels to the original quote because of supply issues. Turned up on time and installation went well. Cleaned up after.Organised the grid connection and supplied all the warranty and paperwork
Rob and the team did a Fabulous job. From the quote, to the planing, design and installation.The system is working incredibly well and looks great.Thanks to SolarQuotes for the recommendation.Kurt

I obtained two quotes from installers via SolarQuotes, both companies sales team were really great but we felt the solution from Progress just suited us better.After researching on the SolarQuotes site we decided to place the maximum amount of panels on the roof, which was 30 REC panels (11.1KW)The install was delayed a couple of months due to lack of hardware, but were prewarned about the delay and Rob kept us regularly informed.The installation was performed over two days due to the rain and we have a steep roof, making it impossible to install during wet weather. As part of the installation they removed the original 1.5KW invertor and the original 8 PV panels.I cannot speak highly enough of the PE team, the install was painless and they did a neat job. They removed the old system and cleaned up the site taking all packaging rubbish with them.Prior to the install we had our 20 year old solar hot water system removed as it was no longer performing and we installed a standard electric water heater. We have ordered (awaiting available stock) the SolarEdge Hot Water diverterThe system is working well

A truly great experience from the quoting stage, throughout the installation and the handover, everything has gone seamless. The team were punctual, installation was neat and tidy, all rubbish removed from site. The after sales customer service has been second to none.I am glad I went with Progress Electrical for my solar installation!!
Quote process was easy and informativeInstallers were friendly and helpfulGrid connection went smoothly

Quoting and Sales process was efficient and professional.The installation was held up due to the wet weather conditions in NSW at the time. The installation was a smooth process, the installer answered all questions asked, arrived on site at the time organised and and did an excellent job.Customer service was excellent

Rob was a very pleasant sales person, and explained the whole package adequately, and supplied answers to all my questions. Two options were provided for me to review. Detailed sheets were provided on all the components. Rob was always available by phone to give me updates on installation time frames.Installation was completed today, very efficiently. Andrew and his team were punctual, and completed the installation with no fuss, and inside the quoted time frame. The team stayed until all panels were operating properly, and proved that power was being generated.I've received an email from Progress Electrical with the grid connection application, and need to rely on the energy supplier to complete that process, trusting they will be as efficient as Progress Electrical.

Salesperson fairly junior but quickly recognised limitations and arranged for senior designer/installer to come out and look at the site and answer questions. Only designer who modified standard installation to take into account possible winter shade.Company had a special deal on top quality panels for less than middle grade panels from other installers so were able to give the lowest quote.Installers turned up with two extra staff so that installation could be done in one rather than two days (installation done on one of the few fine days in the wet weather in late March). Monitored system for next few days and sent someone to adjust inverter to cope with high voltages on network. Will continue to monitor system to make sure design changes to cope with winter shade are effective. If not, offered to move panels as required at no cost to us.Multiple calls and checks to make sure we were happy with installation process and installation itself.Installer did all the work to organised the meter change necessary for grid connection.Could not be happier with the process and have already recommended them to friends and family.
Had the installation yesterday, Rob, Mitch and team have been great to deal with, gave good advice, the installation was done very professionally. Very happy with the overall experience.

From the very start the team were professional, friendly and reliable.Sales:Rob contacted me and led me through all of the questions that I had about the design, size, equipment choice and about a million other questions that I had prior to pulling the trigger. The price was very competitive while offering a very high quality system that fitted my needs now and into the future.Install:The install team, led by Mitch were on time, efficient and really clever to make some decisions relating to the install that made it that little bit tidier or more efficient including some really innovative wiring solutions achangings well as modifying the panel layout slightly so that some shading could be avoided while also allowing for a potential future system size upgrade. They communicated clearly with me along the way and left a clean worksite.After sales service:There were some issues with the consumption monitor that were diagnosed quickly and attended the site to reaolve the issues. The team were approachable and didn't treat me like an idiot with all of my questions and concerns. Happy to report the system is now functioning brilliantly!
Everything ran smoothly from the quote till after installation. Good communication and arranged metering with energy supplier.
Yes.Explained what they would submit application the following day.I have been contacted by supplier and all is set up.

I found the Progress Electrical team really easy to work with. Everyone was helpful and answered any questions I had about the panels, price and installation. The installation team was punctual and cleaned up everything when finished. Grid connection process was organised the next business day and everything seems to be on track.

Rob was an honest and non pushy salesman A+. We went for the REC Alpha series as their quality, warranty and performance over time seemed to be towards the top end of the solar panel industry without top end prices.  The installation process once started by the electricians was very quick and easy. They advised me of the steps required post installation (app setup and whatnot) and post cares/maintenence of the solar panels. Excellent, clear and quality process from start to finish.

From the time first I met with Rob from Progress to today when Mitch and his team installed the system I congratulate the company on their great customer service, attention to detail, prompt response to any questions and the quality workmanship of the installation, I have no hesitation in recommending the company to any potential customer in the Hunter region considering solar panels.

2 out of the 3 quoters attended the site. These guys put up with me for several days while i changed panel layout, system size and panel quality to suit my needs and budget. I decided on a 10 kw system, 17 panels facing North and 10 facing West. The total install only took a day.At the end of the day I was very happy with the service that i received and i would recommend them to anyone.

Sales process was great, reviewed needs, install process, location and choice of quality of components. Flexible with design to meet my needs, reviewed pricing accordingly. Installers professional, safety focused and install neat.

Progress Electrical and Solar were one of three recommended by SolarQuotes. All three visited our home.PROBLEMS WITH SITE:I have a shading problem during winter so the right combination of equipment was very important.THE COMPANY:Salesman: It was nice to have a salesman who listened to my objectives and then talked through each point with patient detail when I did not understand something. He did not 'push' anything - just pointed out the alternatives. I wanted REC panels and we discussed my choice.After a lengthy meeting, my desired system was refined until I was happy 'everything fitted'.INSTALLATION:The Team installing the system were polite, efficient and careful. Explanations were happily given.I am very happy with what I have. The electrical installers even placed the box at a height I can reach (I am in a wheelchair) without having to be asked. They did discuss it with me which was good.The whole installation was done in a day. I'm told that's pretty normal. It was very carefully cleaned up and nothing has been found - particularly that could puncture a wheelchair tyre. Thanks!All paperwork was organised by the company. I have done nothing. Very smooth.RECOMMENDATION:I highly recommend Progress Electrical and Solar.

Sales manager arrived at the appointed time; answered my questions without waffling; gave details of the better systems.No pressure to choose!Installation went very well. Installers arrived on time and were unobtrusive during installation.My electricity provider has to install a new meter - so not yet connected to the grid.   There was some confusion there, because I was advised to speak to the provider before installation, whereas the installer had not then provided the certification papers to arrange the new meter.

I had a fantastic experience with the whole team. All appointments were kept and on time. The sales person listened to my goals and gave advice around the best fit. He provided me with factual evidence based information, which has proved to be spot on. The installation team came and did the install with a minimum of fuss. All they guys were very polite and courteous. I couldn't be happier with our system. I highly recommend to anyone looking at Progress Electrical.
Couldn't fault any of the process and the customer service was outstanding

Progress Electrical were excellent from the start. I was very disappointed with the other 2 companies, one just rung up and tried to sell me the world, whilst the other didn't make contact directly with me at all. That just emailed a quote,  so it made the decision pretty easy as to who to go with.Like I said I can't fault Progress electrical, they were here when they said they would be to quote, they turned up on the day date and time specified and were very helpful with the after sales stuff.

From start to finish Rob, Mitch and the whole team made our experience hassle free and so easy to deal with, highly recommend this company.Price was fantastic, and having a company director be apart of the install was fantastic.
Professional from start to finish. The team from Progress Electrical and Solar delivered on price, quality and installation keeping us informed all the way through the process

Of the 3 quotes Progress Electrical were the only ones to visit the property during the quote process. Dan was a pleasant and engaged young man not pushy and spent the time to include a run thru the fone app for the system.It was not the lowest quote but all 3 were in a similar cost range making the choice more on the quality of the solar panels and inverter using your ratings to heip decide on a system in the upper middle range.I chose the 6.6kw system with rec-300 N-Peak panels and the Solar Edge SE6000HThe install was issue free Andrew was easy to work with as regards location of the inverter etc and the install team were punctual and tidyThe installation date was delayed by about 4 weeks but I was was kept informed and it was not an issue for me.The system was up and running by about 2pm on the day and grid connection was in operation by the following day.Overall a very seamless and hassle free process. Well done Progress Electrical

We were impressed right from the start with the professional presentation and understanding our needs.  Only quality products used and installation was super efficient.  The quote was detailed but easy to understand.The people who own the business actually do the work, not some unrelated contractors.Follow up after installation was excellent. Grid connection was arranged in a timely manner and everything exceeded our expectations.Thoroughly recommended.
Quoting thorough, clear and efficient. Installation smooth. Customer service top class.

Of the three quotes, two visited the site to ensure the specifics required to meet our electricity consumption.Rob Croy of PE explained the details of his quote, gave us the option of two installations, with brochures for the two types of panels recommended, and the inverter.I made several enquiries relating to the selection of panels and the size of array by email which were replied promptly by telephone.Installation was completed efficiently in one day.

During Covid 19 Rob came to see us, we sat down on our back deck & he clearly explained everything giving us a couple of options & explaining the differences between them. He was very knowledgeable about installation, he also checked the power box identified what was required.Mitchell turned up as arranged on time for the installation, he was very polite & efficient. The install was done in a day, the mounting of the inverter was done neatly & located where I asked it to be. All wiring is out of sight fed up inside the wall & inside the roof cavity. All rubbish was removed & site left clean & tidy.I was connected to the app for the inverter, shown how to use it to check its operation & shown how to shut down the system if it is ever needed. All documentation with my electricity supplier was taken care of for me.Happy to recommend the team from Progress Electrical & SolarJeff.

The response from Progress Electrical was like, the next day and when a date and time for the quote was agreed apon, they weren't late and the professionalism I received from Rob was informative and helpful in every way. On the day of installation Andrew and his crew were polite and understanding to my requests, cleaned up and the whole process took only half a day.
Excellent service. Good quality products used. Installers were effecient, polite and tidy.

Best equipment fronius and rec panels and the best price. Kept to their words at every stage. Provided all information. Respectful and professional. Have their own installation team. Very happy I went with them.
Rob was extremly noligable and helping us decide what system was best for us. I would recommened them to anyone.

Sales and quoting process was simple and easy to understand. They were not pushy. The installation was faster than expected and the guys who came out were polite, informative, tidy, and punctual. I would not hesitate to recommend them to others.
